data.name: Will
data.gender_notes: Will is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'willa' or 'wilian', meaning 'to want' or 'to will'. In the Middle Ages, 'will' was used to mean the person's inner most self and willpower. In Christian context, the name symbolizes the power of God's will in the life of a believer. The name Will carries the meaning “Will, desire, or volition” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Will usually hope their child will grow to embody will, desire, or volition and live with faith, good character and purpose.
